scope: Rights attestation adapter, recovery integration, authored tests and operator documentation only. No actual rights grants, legal conclusions, human approvals, publication or project-wide completion.
method: Read repaired adapter and integration plus tests/documentation; reviewed inherited evidence-path checks and rights triage identity handling. No implementation edits or additional tests run by this reviewer.
supported_repairs: Policy binds exact inventory digest, intended use and distribution scope, preventing unrelated private-reference scope from clearing a different intended target.
Full-distribution condition stays false for partial receipt sets.
Expiry is timezone-bearing, future and bound into every exact evidence subject.
Literal boolean decisions reject numeric/string substitutes; identities and independent roles are enforced.
Attestation acquisition/current-time bounds and ordered decision sequence are checked.
Final digest re-read rejects substituted evidence under immutable snapshot assumptions.

findings.detail: Corpus artifact rows are collapsed into artifacts_by_id before rights_accounting receives list(values). Duplicate artifact IDs can disappear before the adapter's duplicate validation; policy inventory digest then binds a deduplicated subset rather than original complete rows.
findings.proposed_repair: Read original rows, reject duplicate artifact IDs and source/commit/path identities before dict construction, pass original full rows to rights_accounting. Compare exact corpus identities/digests against locked source inventories to prevent same-count missing/extra substitution.
suggested_tests: Recovery rejects duplicate corpus artifact IDs before receipts/policy can count.
Recovery rejects foreign/missing/substituted corpus artifact identity despite matching inventory counts.

authority_boundary: Separately approved policy authenticity, human identity and legal substance remain trusted external judgments. A JSON name or digest does not establish actual human approval. These limits are not represented as an automated legal decision.
remaining_scope: Additional root integration repairs and tests pending; no global gate or actual per-file rights closure endorsed.
